stages.name: 密林の頂
stages.description: 緑の海から神殿が現れる

stages.name: 蔦の石段
stages.prompt: beautiful anime illustration, steep carved stone stairway wrapped in vines and moss, shafts of green-gold light, humid haze, intricate relief carvings

stages.name: 聖なる泉
stages.description: セノーテに光が降り注ぐ
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, circular limestone cenote with turquoise water, sunbeams streaming through an opening above, hanging roots, glowing depth

stages.name: 太陽の儀式
stages.description: 日の光が神殿の中心を貫く
stages.prompt: dramatic anime scene, beam of sunlight striking a temple altar at solstice, glowing jade and gold carvings, swirling dust, powerful symmetrical composition

stages.name: 夜の鳥の声
stages.prompt: poetic anime jungle night, stone temple under a dense starfield, drifting fireflies and soft mist, deep teal and indigo, quiet afterglow
